about.title: Hawthorne Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Hawthorne sits in the middle of the South Bay's commuter grid, and its streets show it. In 2025, this Los Angeles County city recorded 328 injury collisions, leaving 416 people hurt and taking three lives. Prairie Avenue, El Segundo Boulevard, Rosecrans Avenue, and 120th Street carry the highest collision counts in the public record, and reports cluster on Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m., when the week's final commute is at its heaviest. If you were injured in one of those crashes, the days that follow can feel scattered: adjusters calling, a car in the shop, medical appointments you never planned for. LawProactive exists to take one task off that list. We are not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Hawthorne residents with an independent personal injury attorney who handles car accident claims on contingency, meaning nothing is owed unless there is a recovery. You tell us what happened, and we make the introduction. The attorney takes it from there.

whyChoose.title: Why Hawthorne Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Deadlines Are Tracked From Day One
items.desc: California generally allows two years to file a car accident injury claim, but that window can shrink to as little as six months when a city, county, or state agency is involved. An attorney in our network can sort out which deadline applies to your Hawthorne crash before it becomes a problem.

items.title: Partial Fault Does Not Close the Door
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still recover compensation even if you shared some blame for the collision; your recovery is reduced by your percentage of fault rather than eliminated. That matters when the other insurer tries to pin the crash on you.

items.title: Evidence and Recorded Statements Are Handled Carefully
items.desc: Photos, dashcam footage, witness contacts, and repair estimates fade or disappear quickly, and the other driver's insurer will often ask for a recorded statement early. A connected attorney can preserve what matters and speak to the insurer for you, so an offhand remark is not used against your claim.

items.question: I was hit on El Segundo Boulevard during Friday rush hour. Who do I call first?
items.answer: Your health comes first, so get checked by a doctor even if you feel mostly fine, since adrenaline can mask injuries for a day or two. Then gather what you can: photos of both vehicles, the other driver's insurance details, and names of anyone who saw the crash. Hawthorne collision reports run heaviest on Friday afternoons, so witnesses may be commuters who are hard to track down later. When you are ready, LawProactive can connect you with an attorney who handles the insurer contact from there.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: You are not required to give the other insurer a recorded statement, and attorneys in our network generally advise against it. Adjusters are trained to ask questions in ways that can minimize your injuries or shift fault. It is reasonable to say you will speak with them after you have talked to an attorney.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect me with an attorney?
items.answer: No. Our connection service is free, and we are not a law firm ourselves. The independent attorneys we connect you with work on contingency, so their fee comes out of any recovery rather than from your pocket up front. If there is no recovery, there is no attorney fee.
